stemMarkdown: The price of an article is increased by 37% and the new price is then decreased by 13%. Find the net percentage change in the price. (Enter a negative value for a net decrease.)
solutionMarkdown: Start from 100. After the increase: $100 \times (1 + 37/100) = 137.00$. After the decrease: $137.00 \times (1 - 13/100) = 119.19$. Net change $= 19.19\%$.
